# WorldEye

> WorldEye is a live 3D intelligence globe on the web. It puts 76,000+ live public cameras, real-time flight and satellite tracking, weather radar, earthquakes and wildfires on one interactive globe. The map is free to use with no account; WorldEye Pro adds an AI analyst, satellite map view, global search and premium intelligence feeds.

## Product

- [Live globe](https://worldeye.app/): The WorldEye app — a live 3D globe with cameras, flights, satellites, weather, earthquakes and wildfires, free with no signup.
- [Features](https://worldeye.app/features): Everything WorldEye does — live layers, OSINT tools, the AI analyst and Pro capabilities.
- [Live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras): Browse 76,000+ live public cameras worldwide — traffic, cities, landmarks, beaches, airports and nature.
- [God's Eye View](https://worldeye.app/gods-eye-view): How WorldEye compares as a hosted, no-install "god's eye view" of Earth with 76,000+ cameras.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://worldeye.app/pricing): Free globe for everyone. Pro is weekly $3.99, monthly $9.99 or annual $59.99, with free trials on the weekly (1 day) and annual (3 days) plans.
- [FAQ](https://worldeye.app/faq): Answers about the free map, Pro, trials, billing, cameras and privacy.
